claim_summary: Exact optimal integer-threshold reduction for any one-bit count encoding of a Poisson counting-path integral, with a sharp high-intensity captured-variance fraction 16/(9π) and globally optimal sample time converging to 2/3.
integrity: Analytical proof and an accompanying standard-library reproducibility checker; no claim of independent mathematical certification.
limitations: Known Poisson rate and unit horizon
One predetermined noiseless count, one deterministic binary message
Quadratic Bayes error for integrated count only
Finite-intensity global maximizers given as exact search problem, not closed form
title: Optimal one-bit quadrature of a Poisson counting path: exact thresholds and a sharp high-intensity limit
